Goldens produced by project-documents bin/script-typeset-reference.py (project-documents commit 9baf7c6) run with TS_REGISTRY pointing at ../precedent/registry:
  python3 bin/script-typeset-reference.py css --out DIR      -> css/<component>.css
  python3 bin/script-typeset-reference.py dtcg [--family F]  -> dtcg-*.json
classes-canada.tsv is the Rust output, reviewed by hand (no Python equivalent).
